say: So where is it going? Start with what has already landed since this presentation was first recorded — this roadmap has a habit of turning into the changelog. Example hives and tutorial courses: first boot lands somewhere alive, and the hive teaches the hive. Build revisions: every build of the software itself is tracked as a named, adoptable revision. Mobile, usable first: the close-up becomes the phone's home screen, and a shared link opens a live hive. And the participant stack — one hexagon with depth, where the wheel rolls through everyone's version of a cell — straight off this presentation's own vision slide.
